name: Leena AI
tagline: Autonomous AI agents for HR, IT, and finance service desks.
description: Leena AI is an autonomous agentic platform for enterprise back-office service desks — HR, IT, and finance — rather than recruiting. It ships pre-built 'AI Colleagues' that auto-resolve employee tickets, answer policy questions, and generate documents, integrating with 200+ enterprise systems. It claims 70%+ ticket auto-resolution across 500+ enterprises.
insight: Raised a $30M Series B led by Bessemer Venture Partners (with Eduardo Saverin) in Sept 2021.
edge: Targets post-hire HR and employee operations (service desk, ticket auto-resolution) rather than recruiting — broadening the category beyond hiring.

references.title: Leena AI Announces $30M Series B led by Bessemer
